description: Get the FIXED, versioned local build kit for talks, so local agents stop improvising their own code: files { 'bauen.py', 'spickkarten-vorlage.html' (same cue-card template as export_cue_cards), 'README.md', 'skript-beispiel.json' }, input_schema (JSON schema of the skript JSON), usage. Write all files UNCHANGED into one folder and run them: `python bauen.py skript.json --nur-pruefung` (full-text timing check: words, estimate at wpm vs planned seconds), `--deck folien.pdf --ohne-video` (+ offline cue cards with slide images), without flag (+ voice-over draft video .mp4 + .srt via edge-tts >= 7.3.1 and ffmpeg; the timing check then adds the measured voice duration). Never edit the files — put talk-specific things (deck, language, voice, pronunciation, output name) into the JSON or arguments. Optional: presentation_id + variant_id|language → also returns input (the skript JSON prefilled from the variant's notes in talk order); page_numbering 'slide_position' (default: folie = slide number in the deck) or 'talk_order' (folie = page of the PDF from render_presentation); wpm. Returns { version, files, input_schema, usage, input? }.

page_numbering.description: How 'folie' is numbered: slide number in the deck (default) or PDF page in talk order

wpm.description: Speaking rate in words per minute for timing estimates

name: get_presentation_kit
